epic.title: Epic 569: attestation that can fail — evidence, review, instruments
epic.intent_and_why: Make a green qualitative gate mean something by telling the agent what would count at plan time, not by telling it at attest time that it got it wrong. 65 of 105 conditions in the shipped spine templates are check:null.

definition_of_done: A qualitative condition declares, at plan time, what evidence would satisfy it.
A wedged verdict is impossible to express silently.
The journal distinguishes a repaired fail from a gate that never failed.
Every check this epic ships is reachable from a template command check, or allowlisted with a stated reason.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: This epic must not add machinery that is itself unwired.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Measured census plus red-proof pinned to the shipped revision; a report-only check must name its promotion trigger.
good_enough.appetite: Four waves; cleared autonomous through wave 2, stop-and-present before wave 3.

hard_constraints: Report-only is a staging state for an unmeasured signal, never a substitute for adjudication.
Sonnet for every commander and crew slot; escalate to opus only on a double block.
Fix or write an episode; filing an issue is the disfavoured exit.
Do not engage the spec-to-template migration (human ruling; episodes/active/569-001.md).
fixed_decisions: Delivery-first inversion: the built-not-wired guarantee ran first, not last.
WP5 reviewer machinery stays inside 569 as wave 4.
#558 is a design question settled with the human before wave 3, not dispatched to a commander.
The declared basis lands in hand-written templates, not through generate_spine.py.

current_wave.objective: Close the epic on its measured shape: promote the conditions that can become real checks today, make a proof fail when its basis drifts, restore the merge-ref signal that already exists, and stop a crew inheriting its dispatcher's door.
exit_criteria: Every promoted condition in w3-promote is red-proved against the shipped revision, and the number promoted is reported alongside the number assessed per template.
The three CommanderSpineBasisFields tests ASSERT rather than skip; a planted template edit makes them red, an unrelated commit elsewhere leaves them green.
The ubuntu-latest CI job is green on the PR that adds it, and windows-latest is still present and still red.
A real dispatched child with spine=None carries neither SPINE_FILE nor SPINE_SESSION; a child with --spine still gets its own correct pair.
Main is verified green in a clean detached worktree after all four merges, by the Admiral, on the merged tree.

Per lane, the pre-declared refresh comparison is recorded: refresh-request count, whether a relaunch actually happened, attempt/total_rework, reviewer verdict and round count, and whether verify-before-merge caught anything the lane missed.

issues.title: Promote bucket-2 qualitative conditions to real check kinds (family A)
issues.desired_outcome: Qualitative `check: null` conditions that a direct check-kind promotion already satisfies become real, failing checks across the shipped spine templates -- using check kinds that already exist, with no new mechanism.
issues.useful_now: It is the epic's filed thesis, the highest-yield work identified in the interrogation, and it costs no new machinery: ~9/19 measured in COMMANDER_SPINE, extrapolating to roughly 31 of 65.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: Each promoted condition is a check that has been red-proved against the shipped revision; the count promoted per template is reported alongside how many were assessed, so a small number is a measured result rather than a shortfall.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose which conditions and which kinds; choose per-template ordering.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do not add a new check kind -- promotion only, using kinds that already exist.
Do not roll out the `basis` field across the 65 (decision:no-basis-backfill).
A promoted check ships blocking only where the adjudication is available at authoring time; otherwise report-only WITH a named promotion trigger in the same PR.
local_unknowns: Whether templates other than COMMANDER_SPINE partition like the measured 9/19 -- this is the knowingly accepted extrapolation risk and MUST be recorded per condition; a material divergence is a replan trigger, not something to absorb.

issues.title: Evidence carries its basis; drift FAILS instead of skipping (family B)
issues.desired_outcome: A proof carries the basis it was taken against, and relying on it re-checks that basis. Concretely: CommanderSpineBasisFields is re-pinned to the blob OID of COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json rather than whole-repo HEAD, and drift FAILS with a re-run instruction rather than calling skipTest.
issues.useful_now: Family B is one defect with one remedy (human ruling), wave 2 already produced an unprompted prototype of it, and the three tests are inert on main right now.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: The three tests assert (not skip) against the shipped template; a planted template edit makes them RED with the stale-proof message; an unrelated commit elsewhere in the repo leaves them GREEN -- which is the exact granularity defect being fixed and must be demonstrated both ways.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the mechanism shape and where the re-verify path lives.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Ship the RE-VERIFY path alongside the guard. A fail-on-drift whose only remedy is an expensive manual re-pin is how a guard becomes something agents route around.
Do not extend this to the qualitative-condition population -- that is a different population and decision:no-basis-backfill governs it.
local_unknowns: Whether the re-verify path can be made cheap enough that the guard is not routed around.

issues.title: Restore the merge-ref signal: add an ubuntu-latest job to CI (family C)
issues.desired_outcome: A red CI means something. `.github/workflows/ci.yml` gains an `ubuntu-latest` job alongside the existing `windows-latest` one, so the merge-ref test that ALREADY RUNS produces a trustworthy verdict.
issues.useful_now: The defence against a PR that reds main already exists and already went red on #645; it was ignored because the last 12 runs are 12 failures. Restoring the signal is strictly cheaper than building a second defence.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: The ubuntu job is green on the PR that adds it; a deliberately broken commit pushed to a scratch branch turns it red. Windows stays red and that is expected, not a failure of this lane.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the job's Python version and step layout; match the existing job where sensible.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do NOT attempt to fix the Windows failures -- explicitly out of scope, and the human ruled Windows stays known-red.
Do not delete or disable the windows-latest job.
Any CI change beyond adding this one job is SURFACED, not delegated.
local_unknowns: Whether ubuntu is green first try -- local is 3731 passed on Linux, so it should be, but a CI-only failure is a real finding rather than a blocker.

issues.title: A crew dispatched without --spine gets NO door, not its dispatcher's
issues.desired_outcome: `_crew_door_env` explicitly clears SPINE_FILE and SPINE_SESSION when `spine` is None, instead of leaving the dispatching process's ambient pair inherited.
issues.useful_now: All 7 cli-backend crews this wave hit the trap and each rediscovered it independently; it is the same defect class as the wave-1 Admiral dispatch error, which cost w1-wiring its independent review.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A real dispatched child with no --spine has neither variable in its environment; a child WITH --spine still gets its own correct pair. Must be verified against an ACTUAL dispatched child, not only a unit test of the env dict.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose how the clear is expressed.
hard_constraints_no_gos: The docstrings at run_crew.py:1280 and :1333-1341 currently frame inheritance as the SAFE fallback and MUST be edited in the same change, or the next reader restores the old behaviour as a bug fix.
This lane edits the launcher it is itself dispatched through -- do not break dispatch for the sibling lanes.
local_unknowns: Whether any caller legitimately depends on the inherited pair.

parked_possibilities: The stalled spec-to-template migration: 2 specs against 19 roles, already drifted. Human ruled it out of 569; recorded as episodes/active/569-001.md.
Imperative bloat across the remaining spine steps.
Whether record() on a survey should evaluate null-kind postconditions (#422 D-scope).

ADMIRAL_SPINE.template.json declares no child_checklist on any step although its latitude imperative says to load constellation-interrogator, and rescope cannot add one -- so an Admiral's interrogation survey has no door to descend through. Built-not-wired, in the Admiral's own spine.

checklist_engine.py append() has no `kind` parameter, so an appended survey question is untyped; verify_interrogation.py validates the HAND-AUTHORED record rather than the engine-driven survey, and nothing binds the two together.
map_orient verify-frame rejects decision:X under DEGRADED -- never examined this run.
The Windows CI job's own failures: autocrlf `git apply --cached ... patch does not apply` and a Windows temp-path `git clone --bare`. Explicitly out of w3-ci's scope by human ruling.

The replan schema has no way to record a fixed-boundary change (intent_and_why, definition_of_done, good_enough, hard_constraints, fixed_decisions) that the human already authorised out-of-band: it forces applicable=false plus a one-boundary escalation packet, which refuses the launch. Hit at the w2-to-w3 boundary.

wave_evidence.claim: Restoring one CI job restores a signal and nothing more
wave_evidence.expected: a green Linux job; Windows stays red on known platform bugs
wave_evidence.observed: MUCH more. Looking at CI at all revealed (a) main was UN-CHECKOUTABLE on Windows -- 40 files committed under a literal .agent-work/<work-id>/ directory, git refusing < and > so checkout died before any test ran; (b) the e2e suite had NEVER passed in CI, because `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` is relative in a plain checkout and absolute only in a linked worktree, and everyone here runs from worktrees; (c) the Skip guard step had never RUN, because the suite step failed ahead of it on every prior build. Three defects hidden behind one uninformative red.

wave_evidence.claim: A lane fixing a defect prevents a sibling lane from copying it
wave_evidence.expected: w3-basis removing skip-on-drift means the pattern stops spreading
wave_evidence.observed: FALSE. w3-promote branched from the same base and copied the pre-repair pattern into six new classes -- 35 inert assertions -- with a docstring citing the very class being repaired three worktrees away. Concurrent lanes off one base do not see each other's fixes, and the launch orders never said so.
wave_evidence.source: pytest -k W3Promote -> 35 skipped; the classes' own docstrings

wave_evidence.claim: The extrapolation from one template's 9/19 generalises to the corpus
wave_evidence.observed: FALSE, and the guard written to catch it caught it. 16 of 65. 5 of 7 non-baseline templates fell outside the predicted [30%,65%] band, every one low. Bucket-2 density tracks template SHAPE, not identity.
